proposal.reasoning: The application handles about 36.8 requests per second with active database connections peaking at 49 out of 50 and mean acquisition time being very low (6.56 ms), showing the connection pool is not exhausted. The hold time per request is around 1.3 seconds (49 active connections / 36.79 rps), which is vastly longer than a normal query should take. Furthermore, the batch fetch and JDBC batch sizes are set to 1 (`spring.jpa.properties.hibernate.default_batch_fetch_size` and `spring.jpa.properties.hibernate.jdbc.batch_size` are both 1), indicating an N+1 query problem causing high latency inside the database interaction. Increasing the batch size will reduce the number of roundtrips.
